scope: Curated 8 of 21 islands; named docks are orientation references, NOT verified GPS landing waypoints
seasonCaveat: 2026 shuttle and dock evidence must be reverified for future seasons

islands.name: Stockton Island
islands.overview: Walk from Presque Isle through pine woods to Julian Bay, or continue deeper into the island where an old quarry and quieter shoreline await.
islands.landing: Presque Isle east/west public docks; Quarry Bay public dock
islands.transport: Operator lists a seasonal Stockton day-hiking shuttle and overnight camping shuttle; the published 2026 season has ended.
trails: From the Presque Isle ranger station to Julian Bay beach.
Wooded route between Julian Bay and the dock.
A lagoon outlet can require wading.
islands.camp: NPS designated campsites; accessible site 1 at Presque Isle and group A/B at Quarry Bay. Permits and transport required.
islands.warning: A Presque Isle–Quarry Bay trail bridge was washed out; check current crossing conditions before choosing longer routes.

islands.name: Oak Island
islands.overview: Follow old beach ridges through hardwood forest to a view of islands and the Hole-in-the-Wall sea arch.
islands.landing: Public west-side dock; sandspit landing is a separate small-craft decision
islands.transport: Operator lists a seasonal overnight camping shuttle; it is not advertised as a regular same-day hiking shuttle.
trails: Horseshoe hike rising over the lakeshore's highest island point.
Branch from the loop trail; overlook is 3.5 miles from dock.
Beach walk toward campsites, stay on established trail or sand.
islands.camp: Designated individual and group sites; check the exact campsite's dock or sandspit approach.
islands.warning: An outbound ferry or shuttle ticket is not proof of a same-day return. Arrange pickup in advance.

islands.name: Sand Island
islands.overview: The path from East Bay leads toward an 1881 brownstone lighthouse and an old keeper's view of western Lake Superior.
islands.landing: Public East Bay dock (no dock at Lighthouse Bay verified)
islands.transport: No regular Sand Island landing shuttle verified. Arrange an authorized water taxi or suitable private boat and return.
trails: From East Bay dock to the lighthouse; wet boardwalks may be slippery.
Old roadbed south past designated camping areas.
islands.camp: Designated sites and group sites; NPS identifies accessible site 3 and group C by East Bay boardwalk. Permit required.
islands.warning: West Bay Club is closed, southeastern private docks are not public, and NPS says campsite coordinates are being corrected.

islands.name: Raspberry Island
islands.overview: A white lighthouse, forest canopy and small beach invite a quieter historical stop.
islands.landing: Public east and west docks by the light station
islands.transport: Operator publishes a seasonal Raspberry Island lighthouse tour with island time; confirm the future season and on-site tour access.
trails: From light station toward views of Sand Island.
Old-growth forest route to the southeast beach.
islands.camp: No designated campsites listed; Raspberry is excluded from primitive camping zones. Treat it as a day visit.
islands.warning: This is Wisconsin's Apostle Islands Raspberry Island, not Isle Royale's island with the same name.

islands.name: Michigan Island
islands.overview: The light station and lagoon trail lead away from the open lake toward a remote island shoreline.
islands.landing: Public dock at Michigan Island light station
islands.transport: A Michigan Island lighthouse excursion is advertised; verify whether a specific departure actually lands and permits touring.
trails: From the light station to sandspit campsites.
Trail appears to end at a bog before resuming farther on.
islands.camp: NPS lists designated Michigan Island campsite options. Book a permit and arrange round-trip transport separately.
islands.warning: The bog crossing is not a continuous surfaced trail; sightseeing on water does not guarantee an island landing.

islands.name: Rocky Island
islands.overview: Small stretches of shore and modest wooded trails offer a less crowded island experience.
islands.transport: No scheduled passenger shuttle confirmed; plan a water taxi or private vessel with a verified return.
trails: Wooded trail across the island from the dock.
Past campsite area north of the public dock.
islands.camp: Designated and group camping; permit required.
islands.warning: Private land north of Group Site A is not publicly accessible. Never use private docks as an access suggestion.

islands.name: Basswood Island
islands.overview: A substantial loop through old farm ground and stone-working sites tells the history of the lake's industrial shores.
islands.transport: No regular passenger shuttle verified. Arrange licensed water transport or private boating and a return.
trails: NPS loop from dock through McCloud-Brigham farm site and the historic brownstone quarry.
islands.camp: NPS campsite directory lists designated Basswood campsites; backcountry permit required.
islands.warning: The quarry is historic industrial terrain; stay on maintained routes and do not enter unsafe structures.

islands.name: Devils Island
islands.overview: The outer island holds some of the most dramatic sandstone sea caves, but a visitor landing itinerary is not currently supportable.
islands.landing: South dock and marina closed for 2026 rehabilitation; no arrival instructions offered
islands.transport: Offshore viewing only when authorized operators and weather permit. Do not plan to land.
trails: Historic trail exists in NPS inventory but the south landing is closed; not a visit recommendation.
islands.camp: NPS ongoing alerts list Devils Island campsites closed; primitive camping not permitted.
islands.warning: Closed dock, boathouse and adjacent areas. A trail entry in NPS inventory does not reopen island access.
